title: Persistent Cognitive Architectures for Human-AI Co-Reasoning: Beyond Retrieval to Structural Intelligence
abstract: Introduces Symbiose, a persistent cognitive architecture that integrates knowledge graphs, vector search, causal tracking, hierarchical memory consolidation, and proactive triggers via the Quantum Leap (QL) orchestration layer. The system provides epistemic honesty through an L0–L3 tagging framework and demonstrates emergent, persistent co-reasoning capabilities in a longitudinal Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) use case beyond stateless RAG baselines.
